Published estimates of non-revenue water (Liemberger & Wyatt 2019) and of physical losses in urban systems (Kingdom et al. 2006), cited in the main text, and the EXA7 sensor ratio (30 sensors for 381 junctions, 7.9%; dataset/Exa7.inp and knowledge_base/sensor_fingerprints.json). No result of this study is shown.

Fig. 1b uses the approved dense schematic. Optional H8 fusion/projection labels are updated to 43.0%/59.7%, means of the strict five-noise-realization rerun (Fig6b_TableS4). Graph and LLM branches retain their separately labelled historical analyses.

Projection-residual Top-1 under H0, H1, H2 and H8, mean ± s.d. over five repetitions (sheet Fig4a_TableS2b_540q). "78% of H2 errors fall in an adjacent partition": 503 of 648 pooled Top-1 errors (sheet FigS2d_adjacent_per_run, sums of n_adjacent_errors and n_errors for H2; pooled confusion counts in sheet FigS2abc_confusion_counts).
GraphSAGE+, Random Forest and projection-residual Top-1 under H0, H2 and H8 on the 90 fixed queries (sheet Fig4bc_TableS2a_90q).

G2 Top-1 of designs A, C60, C90 and B, mean ± s.d. over 15 draws (sheet Fig5_FigS1_TableS3b, group G2, metric top1); "C90 > A in 15 of 15 draws" (sheet Fig5b_TableS3c_pairwise, row C90 vs A: positive 15, non_tied_n 15). "Closed-world protocol (H0) prefers A": G1 Top-1 means of A, C60, C90 and B, the four designs shown (90.3, 88.3, 87.9 and 83.6%; sheet Fig5_FigS1_TableS3b, group G1, metric top1; design A_prime, 90.4%, is not shown in Fig. 1e).
Method schematic and partition maps; no plotted quantities.

Legacy distance sheets use uncalibrated Euclidean map-coordinate distances. New partition/sensor tables use shortest physical pipe-length paths in metres (WNTR SI conversion); predicted candidate-pipe length is a set-extent proxy, not measured field effort.
